# **William Loving**

Hello & Welcome to my Website!

As a student pursuing degrees in Sustainability and Statistics, I am interested in working where climate technology, infrastructure, and data intersect.

I am currently an undergraduate research assistant at the University of Florida's College of Design, Construction, and Planning, conducting research with the [People and Everyday Nature (PEN) Lab](https://penlab.research.st/people). Here, I use R to analyze, clean, and test survey and eye-tracking data about Green Stormwater Infrastructure (GSI). I am also a 2026 Florida Climate Institute Student Fellow, where I am conducting my own research project about the equity of GSI in Alachua County, Gainesville. I use ArcGIS to map GSI locations, EPA stormwater regions, census data, and flood‑vulnerable locations using shapefiles. Both of these roles have allowed me to grow stronger in R, Python, and GIS.
